# Harnesses

<!-- Generated from memory/cli's registry by TestHarnessDocIsCurrent (go test ./cli -run HarnessDoc -args -write); do not edit. -->

`om install <name>` wires om into 198 harnesses. Each entry takes only what the harness's own documentation or source confirms, linked in its last column; `om install --mcp-config <file>` covers any harness with a JSON MCP config not listed here, and [om](universal.md) has the protocol for any other.

## Recording, compaction and the memory tool (13)

Hooks, a plugin or an extension hand om the conversation, and the memory tool reads it.

| Harness | Name | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `claude-code` | `${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.claude}/settings.json` hooks | compaction: om's summary is handed back after Claude's own (SessionStart, source compact) |
| Codex CLI | `codex` | its own config (`om install codex --dry-run` shows the files) | no compaction hook: memory is reached through the tool |
| Factory Droid | `factory-droid` | `~/.factory/mcp.json` `mcpServers` | compaction: om's summary is handed back at the SessionStart after Droid's (source compact) |
| Gemini CLI | `gemini-cli` | `~/.gemini/settings.json` `mcpServers` | compaction: om compacts at PreCompress and hands its summary to the model at the next prompt |
| Gentle Shell | `gentle-shell` | its own config (`om install gentle-shell --dry-run` shows the files) | Pi's extension in Gentle Shell's own home (with --link it uses Pi's: om install pi); [docs](https://github.com/Gentleman-Programming/gentle-shell) |
| GitHub Copilot (CLI, VS Code) | `copilot` | `${COPILOT_HOME:-~/.copilot}/mcp-config.json` `mcpServers` | the CLI's hooks: om compacts at preCompact; Copilot's sessionStart never follows its compaction, so om's summary comes back on resume and through the tool |
| Kilo Code | `kilo-code` | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/kilo/kilo.json` `mcp` | OpenCode's plugin API: level 0 on session.idle; om's summary joins Kilo's compaction context (plugin not yet run inside Kilo) |
| Kimi CLI | `kimi-cli` | `~/.kimi/mcp.json` `mcpServers` | Kimi's hooks cannot hand the model context: om records each turn and compacts with Kimi, and memory is read through the tool |
| Oh My Pi | `oh-my-pi` | its own config (`om install oh-my-pi --dry-run` shows the files) | Pi's extension, which Oh My Pi loads from its own agent directory: om compacts on its cut; the default profile only; [docs](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/main/docs/extension-loading.md) |
| OpenCode | `opencode` | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/opencode.json` `mcp` | plugin: level 0 on session.idle; om's summary joins OpenCode's compaction context |
| Pi | `pi` | its own config (`om install pi --dry-run` shows the files) | extension: om compacts on Pi's own cut and Pi stores it; the tool runs through om call |
| PiG | `pig` | its own config (`om install pig --dry-run` shows the files) | the engine runs inside PiG as its extension, with level 1 on the session model: om install runs pig install |
| Qwen Code | `qwen-code` | `~/.qwen/settings.json` `mcpServers` | compaction: om's summary is handed back at the SessionStart after Qwen's (source compact) |

## The memory tool, installed by om (87)

om writes its MCP server into the harness's config, beside what is there, and uninstall takes out exactly that. The tool serves the curated memory and kept definitions, shared across harnesses.

| Harness | Name | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Agentkube | `agentkube` | `~/.agentkube/mcp.json` `mcpServers` | press Refresh on its MCP page after installing; [docs](https://docs.agentkube.com/agents/mcp.md) |
| AiderDesk | `aider-desk` | `~/.aider-desk/mcp-servers.json` `mcpServers` | AIDER_DESK_HOME_DIR replaces ~/.aider-desk; file is watched, no restart needed; also Settings > MCP Servers > Add; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hotovo/aider-desk/main/docs-site/docs/agent-mode/mcp-servers.md) |
| Amazon Q Developer CLI | `amazon-q` | `~/.aws/amazonq/mcp.json` `mcpServers` | read by an agent only with useLegacyMcpJson: true (Q CLI is being replaced by Kiro) |
| Amp | `amp` | `~/.config/amp/settings.json` `amp.mcpServers` | its hooks are TypeScript plugins, not wired yet |
| AnythingLLM Desktop | `anythingllm` | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/anythingllm-desktop/storage/plugins/anythingllm_mcp_servers.json` `mcpServers` | press Refresh on the Agent Skills page after installing; [docs](https://docs.anythingllm.com/mcp-compatibility/desktop) |
| Augment (Auggie CLI) | `augment` | `~/.augment/settings.json` `mcpServers` | its hooks cannot hand the model context and carry no transcript |
| Autohand Code CLI | `autohand-code` | `${AUTOHAND_HOME:-~/.autohand}/config.json` `mcp.servers` | restart after installing; a config.toml or config.yaml instead of config.json needs /mcp add; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/autohandai/code-cli/HEAD/docs/mcp.md) |
| Axon (formerly Claude Code Open) | `axon` | `${AXON_CONFIG_DIR:-~/.axon}/settings.json` `mcpServers` | [docs](https://registry.npmjs.org/axon-code) |
| BoltAI | `boltai` | `~/.boltai/mcp.json` (darwin) `mcpServers` | then Settings > Plugins > Reload Config; [docs](https://boltai.com/docs/plugins/mcp-servers) |
| Chaterm | `chaterm` | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/Chaterm/setting/mcp_settings.json` `mcpServers` | path is Electron userData/setting/mcp_settings.json with productName Chaterm (global build); the China build (electron-builder.cn.yml) may use a different folder; Cline-derived McpHub watches the file; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chaterm/Chaterm/main/src/main/index.ts https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chaterm/Chaterm/main/src/main/agent/services/mcp/schemas.ts https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chaterm/Chaterm/main/electron-builder.global.yml) |
| ChatMCP | `chatmcp` | `${XDG_DATA_HOME:-~/.local/share}/ChatMcp/mcp_server.json` `mcpServers` | restart ChatMCP after installing; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daodao97/chatmcp/HEAD/lib/utils/storage_manager.dart) |
| Claude Desktop | `claude-desktop` | `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` `mcpServers` |  |
| Cline | `cline` | `${CLINE_MCP_SETTINGS_PATH:-~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json}` `mcpServers` |  |
| Code Puppy | `code-puppy` | `~/.code_puppy/mcp_servers.json` `mcp_servers` | when XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set the file is $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/code_puppy/mcp_servers.json; start servers with /mcp start; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mpfaffenberger/code_puppy/main/code_puppy/config.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mpfaffenberger/code_puppy/main/code_puppy/command_line/mcp/mcp_servers_store.py) |

| Sweep AI (JetBrains) | `sweep` | Shift Shift > Sweep Settings > MCP Servers > Edit MCP Config File (mcpServers JSON) | file path not documented; local servers only; [docs](https://docs.sweep.dev/mcp-servers (via search summary; host unreachable here)) |
| Text Generation WebUI (textgen) | `text-generation-webui` | create user_data/mcp.json (mcpServers map, Claude Desktop format) in the install folder, then restart | file lives under the install directory, not a fixed user path; usable with om install --mcp-config <install>/user_data/mcp.json; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/oobabooga/textgen/Tool-Calling-Tutorial.md) |
| Tome | `tome` | MCP tab > add server, and paste the command | [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runebookai/tome/main/README.md) |
| Tongyi Lingma (Qoder CN) | `lingma` | avatar > Personal settings > MCP Services > + | [docs](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/lingma/user-guide/guide-for-using-mcp) |
| Trae | `trae` | Settings > MCP > Add > Add Manually, and paste it under mcpServers | [docs](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/model-context-protocol) |
| TypingMind | `typingmind` | Settings > Advanced Settings > Model Context Protocol: run the npx @typingmind/mcp connector it shows, then Edit Servers | [docs](https://docs.typingmind.com/model-context-protocol-(mcp)-in-typingmind/use-mcp-with-private-mcp-connector.md) |
| Vercade | `vercade` | add it under mcpServers in the mcp.json the MCP_PATH variable names | [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lintyourcode/vercade/main/README.md) |
| vim-ai | `vim-ai` | no native MCP; with the kracejic/vim-ai-provider-openai-mcp plugin set provider=openai-mcp and options.mcp=<path to a JSON server file> in the [chat] config | third-party provider, stdio only, early version; JSON file schema not documented; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madox2/vim-ai/main/README.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kracejic/vim-ai-provider-openai-mcp/master/readme.md) |
| VT Code | `vtcode` | in vtcode.toml (vtcode --version shows where) set enabled = true under [mcp] and add a [[mcp.providers]] table with name = "om", enabled = true, command and args as below | [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinhnx/vtcode/main/docs/guides/mcp-integration.md) |
| Workshop Desktop (formerly Memex) | `memex` | Settings > MCP Servers > Add Custom Server | [docs](https://docs.workshop.ai/workshop-desktop/mcp-servers.md) |
| Xum (formerly Mux, Coder) | `xum` | Settings > MCP, or in ~/.xum/mcp.jsonc under servers add "om": "<om> mcp --harness xum" (one shell command string; quote om's path if it has spaces) | each server value is ONE shell command string, not an object: quote the om path if it has spaces; also editable in Settings > MCP; older Mux used ~/.mux; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coder/mux/main/docs/config/mcp-servers.mdx) |
| y-cli | `y-cli` | run y-cli mcp add, then list the server in a bot's mcp_servers | [docs](https://pypi.org/project/y-cli/) |
| Yume | `yume` | Yume runs Claude Code and uses its MCP servers: run om install claude-code | [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aofp/yume/main/README.md) |
| ZeroClaw | `zeroclaw` | add a [[mcp.servers]] entry (zeroclaw config set mcp.servers.NAME.command ...) and grant it to an agent through an [mcp_bundles.*] entry in agents.<alias>.mcp_bundles | a server alone is not granted to any agent; grants are per agent alias; [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/master/docs/book/src/tools/mcp.md) |
| Zin MCP Client | `zin-mcp-client` | add it under mcpServers in mcp-config.json beside the zin-mcp-client script, or pass --config <file> | [docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zinja-coder/zin-mcp-client/master/README.md) |

## Researched, not supported

Every client below was checked against its own documentation or source (2026-11-04).

- **No local stdio MCP** (web, remote-only or cloud-run): GitHub Copilot coding agent and Claude Code and Cursor cloud agents (servers run on remote VMs), Memgraph Lab, Android Studio's Gemini, CarrotAI and DocsGPT (HTTP only), FlowDown (sandbox blocks stdio), Archestra (runs servers as Kubernetes pods), Tencent CloudBase AI DevKit, Kibitz (WebSocket bridge), MCP SuperAssistant (a proxy you run), NextChat (server builds), Ontheia (allows only npx, uvx, python or docker commands), Senpi (a hosted agent), Inspector (now Radius, no MCP of its own), mcpc and MCPOmni Connect (no server registry), Postman (ad hoc test requests), Copilot-MCP (an installer for VS Code's config: use `om install copilot`), Qodo Gen (retired 2026-11-01), and the web-only clients on the MCP clients lists (ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Le Chat, Replit Agent, Copilot Studio, v0 and others).
- **Project-level only** (no user-wide config, so nothing to install globally; use `om install --mcp-config` on the project's file): console-chat-gpt, ContextKit, Dolphin-MCP, Fastchat MCP, Enola, MCP Chatbot, MCP Simple Slackbot, Nerve, Dexto, LibreChat (a deployment's librechat.yaml).
- **Unconfirmed** (no documentation found): Ano, ChatFrame, Simple AI, Agent-cli, Deepgram Saga, Highlight AI, Navigator, NULLA, Ravenala, Simtheory, Claude Cowork (likely through Claude Desktop's config), Muse Code.
- **No MCP client a local om can join** (second sweep): Agent Bridge (web platform for remote MCP servers), Aider (no MCP client support in aider itself (see aider-ce for a fork that has it)), Aidermacs (wraps aider; no MCP client), Alpaca (Ollama GTK client) (no MCP in source), Apify Tester MCP Client (hosted Apify Actor, SSE only), AskIt (project-level only: mcp_config.json in the current directory), Bito (Bito ships an MCP server (AI Architect) for other clients; no MCP client config), BrowseWiz (browser side panel; Streamable HTTP/SSE URLs only), ChatGPT desktop (developer-mode connectors take remote MCP URLs only; local stdio belongs to Codex (codex-desktop)), chatgpt-shell (Emacs) (no MCP in code search; same author's agent-shell has it), Copilot for Xcode (intitni) (no MCP; use copilot-for-xcode for GitHub's app), Dify (MCP tools are added as HTTP server URLs only), Elia (no MCP), elizaOS (per-agent only: character settings.mcp.servers with @elizaos/plugin-mcp), Enchanted (no MCP), Firebase Studio (cloud workspace VM; only workspace .idx/mcp.json, so a local om cannot be launched), Glue (hosted team chat, remote MCP), gp.nvim (no MCP in README or code search), GPT4All (no MCP), Groq Code CLI (minimal template CLI with no MCP support), Hugging Face Chat UI (MCP servers are URLs only (MCP_SERVERS env or user-added)), IronClaw (MCP lane is host-mediated HTTP only), Jules CLI (Google) (tasks run on Google's remote VMs; the CLI reference has no MCP configuration), Khoj (admin-registered MCP path runs only a .py/.js script or npm package (python/node/npx), no arbitrary command or args), Klavis AI (hosted Slack/Discord clients and hosted servers), Kodu Claude Coder (no MCP settings in source (code search hits only a lockfile); inactive), Letta (app, CLI, server) (Letta app/CLI point to skills, not MCP; stdio MCP only on a Docker self-hosted server via the API, where a host om path is not reachable), Lutra (hosted agent, remote MCP URL), marimo (MCP client offers only built-in presets (marimo, context7); custom servers not supported yet), MCP Playground (web client for remote servers), mcp-use CLI (server dev/test tool (mcp-use client connect URL); no agent server registry), Melty (no MCP; project inactive (waitlist)), MindPal (hosted no-code platform), Mistral Le Chat (custom connectors are remote MCP URLs only), n8n (MCP Client Tool node connects to SSE/HTTP endpoints only, per workflow), Ollama app (no MCP client; ollama launch only configures other clients), Onit (no MCP in README), Open WebUI (native MCP is Streamable HTTP only; stdio needs the mcpo proxy), Page Assist (browser extension, Streamable HTTP/SSE only), PAR LLAMA (no MCP), Plandex (no MCP support; project wound down in 2025), Qordinate (hosted messaging assistant), RA.Aid (no MCP config; MCP only by writing a Python --custom-tools file that builds a client; inactive since mid-2025), Runbear (Slack/Teams/Discord, SSE only), ShellGPT (sgpt) (function calling via Python files in ~/.config/shell_gpt/functions only, no MCP), Sourcery (Sourcery is a remote MCP server, not a client), Superinterface (hosted assistants, SSE only), Supermaven (sunset 2025-11-21; autocomplete only), Tabby (MCP only via Roo Code integration (om install roo-code)), Tambo (web app framework/platform, no user-level config), Taskade (hosted workspace, remote MCP), Tiles (now an MCP server (tiles mcp) for coding tools, not a client), Toad (batrachian) (ACP front end for other agents; MCP servers are the wrapped agent's own config (MCP UI still on roadmap)), TunaCode (no MCP client in the current codebase), Wave Terminal (Wave AI has no MCP client in the source tree), WhatsMCP (hosted WhatsApp agent).
- **Unconfirmed** (second sweep, no documentation found): AIChat (no native MCP; MCP servers reach it only through the separate llm-functions MCP bridge (sigoden/llm-functions), whose config lives in the user's llm-functions checkout), Baidu Comate (manual reportedly names ~/.comate/mcp.json global, but field names conflict (type vs transportType); not verified), BLACKBOX AI (VS Code) (docs now cover the API only; MCP settings file of the extension not found), Blackbox AI CLI (documents only `blackbox mcp add <name> <url> -t http`; where it stores servers and whether stdio works is not published), Claude Code Open (repository no longer reachable), CodeGeeX (no MCP documentation found), Copilot for Obsidian (agent mode keeps mcpServers in plugin settings (per vault); no documented user path), fast-agent (mcp.servers live in fast-agent.yaml inside the active fast-agent home, which defaults to <workspace>/.fast-agent (or --home / FAST_AGENT_HOME); no fixed user-level file), JoyCode (JD) (mcpServers JSON format documented, file path not), Jupyter AI (only workspace-level <root>/.jupyter/mcp_settings.json documented (list under mcp_servers with name/command/args, env as [{name,value}]); no global file), mcp-cli (chrishayuk) (servers come from server_config.json (--config-file, ./server_config.json, else the bundled one); README says /server add persists to ~/.mcp-cli/preferences.json (servers.runtime_servers) but no command calls that writer in current source), Microsoft Copilot (Windows) (Windows on-device agent registry is for packaged servers; no user config found), Onuro (no MCP documentation found), PearAI (agent is a Roo Code fork; its extension id/storage path not found), SHAI (OVHcloud) (MCP servers are configured only inside custom agent configs (~/.config/shai/agents/<agent>.config, tools.mcp); the default agent has no MCP section), Sidekick (johnbean393) (ships an example servers list with connectionType stdio, but where it is stored is undocumented), SillyTavern (no core MCP; only third-party extensions with undocumented config), Trae Agent (bytedance) (mcp_servers map in trae_config.yaml, read from the current directory (or --config-file / TRAE_CONFIG_FILE); no user-level file), Xcode 26.3 agents (Claude Agent, Codex) (~/Library/Developer/Xcode/CodingAssistant/codex/config.toml is reported rewritten by Xcode; no Apple doc found for custom servers).
